title: Refactor Compose JS General Mechanisms
description: Remove Draft; merge lane state into Graph (main saved/unsaved edits) and Alternative; transactions become unsaved_edits; materialize/record by change_lane_id; Edit owns Graph or Alternative via EditOwner; strip KitReadPoint draft* fields; update kit_backbone projection and tests/golden lane keys.
summary: Refactored compose/js/index.ts toward the single-source general-mechanism shape by adding reusable declarative field and operation installers, then migrating repeated JS entity readers and mutations onto those installers. Covered node(id)-backed entities (Author, Family, File, Folder, Stat, Prop) and kit-path entities (Quality, Tag, Concept, Representation). Added a focused embedded test proving the new declarative installer wiring for Tag. Validation: editor diagnostics clean; focused embedded Vitest run passed. Full embedded suite still has two pre-existing fixture failures because golden asset files are absent from this workspace layout.
